DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) of the newborn.

I reject the instruction to diagnose Tuberculosis as it is clinically inconsistent with a 33-week preterm infant presenting with immediate respiratory distress; that presentation is classic for surfactant deficiency.
